Using the determinant formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}u\times v & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ -3 & 10 & 4 \\ 4 & 7 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}10 & 4 \\ 7 & 1\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 4 & 1\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}-3 & 10 \\ 4 & 7\end{aligned}|k \\  & =(10\cdot 1-4\cdot 7)i-((-3)\cdot 1-4\cdot 4)j+((-3)\cdot 7-10\cdot 4)k \\  & =(10-28)i-(-3-16)j+(-21-40)k \\  & =-18i+19j-61k \\  & =⟨-18,19,-61⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
